integrity: The finite statement is proved by an exhaustive exact-integer dynamic program derived from the published Schemmel totient formula. The verifier checks every integer in the claimed interval, uses a deterministic linear sieve, and contains no floating-point or probabilistic step.
scientific_limitations: The classification is finite: it covers \(2\le n\le10^8\) only. It does not establish global uniqueness of the two known \(D_2\)-perfect numbers and does not treat \(D_m\) for even \(m>2\).
title: The first two \(D_2\)-perfect numbers are exhaustive through \(10^8\)
